svg.title: CHRONA — Top App Bar, 3-Dot Overflow Menu & 5-Destination Bottom Navigation
svg.desc: All 5 active selection states for Alarms, World Clock, Timer, Stopwatch, and Bedtime.

g.text: Top Bar, Overflow Menu & 5-Destination Bottom Nav
Strictly 5 evenly distributed destinations · Rounded Material Symbols · Standardized 3-item overflow menu
A. Top Application Bar (360dp & 412dp) + Global 3-Dot Overflow Menu
B. Five-Destination Bottom Navigation — All 5 Active Selection States (412dp Width · 82.4dp Equal Slots)
Every destination uses an identical 82.4dp column slot, 56×32dp rounded selection pill (#2A384D), and Material Symbols Rounded glyph.
